run_text_detection: run text detection on an image and return detected text polygons with bounding boxes
run_ocr: run OCR on an image with optional math recognition and word-level bounding boxes
run_layout_detection: run layout analysis on an image and return detected layout regions with labels
run_table_recognition: run table recognition on an image and return detected table cells with row and column structures
test_ocr_errors: test a PDF file for garbled or bad OCR text by sampling text and classifying quality
